name: Veracode MCP
description: Enables interaction with the Veracode platform to perform security tasks like running SAST scans, checking SCA vulnerabilities, and retrieving CVE information. It allows AI assistants to manage scan workflows, from zipping source code to analyzing scan results through natural language.
